# API Checklist: Brand-first garage list

**Purpose**: Validate the quality of the requirements for the brand-first garage list API: ordering, counts, paging and cursor, public access, errors.
**Created**: 2026-10-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Ordering

- [x] CHK001 Is the two-group rule stated so that the group of a garage is decided by its answer alone, with `does_not_take` and `unstated` explicitly one group? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Is "name order" defined precisely enough (collation, tie-break) for two reviewers to order the same garages identically? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK003 Is the order inside a group consistent between the user stories, FR-007 and the Assumptions, given that rating-first is deferred? [Consistency, Spec §US3, §FR-007]
- [x] CHK004 Is the out-of-scope status of rating, review count and sort choices stated once and not contradicted elsewhere? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK005 Is it stated that only the requested brand's answer decides the group, not any other brand's rows? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]

## Counts

- [x] CHK006 Are the two counts defined over the same set as the list (approved garages only) and is that set named once? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK007 Are the count field names and their numeric type specified, not only their meaning? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK008 Is the relation between `total` and the two counts stated without ambiguity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK009 Are the zero cases (no approved garage, nobody takes the brand) specified for both counts and list? [Coverage, Spec §US2, §SC-005]
- [x] CHK010 Is the behaviour of counts when data changes between two page reads specified? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Paging and cursor

- [x] CHK011 Is the page size a single stated number with no per-request override left unspecified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK012 Is the content of the cursor and what it must guarantee (no repeat, no skip, no group mixing) specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK013 Is the value of `nextCursor` on the last page specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK014 Is the group-boundary page (a page holding the last takers and the first refusers) described consistently between the scenarios and the success criteria? [Consistency, Spec §US3, §SC-002]
- [x] CHK015 Is the guarantee limited to an unchanged list, with the changed-list behaviour stated as accepted? [Assumption, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK016 Is the trust level of the cursor (opaque, unsigned, validated) and what a forged one yields specified? [Coverage, Spec §Clarifications, §FR-009]

## Public access

- [x] CHK017 Is it stated that the route is open to visitors and how that is made checkable (the public-routes list)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-003, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK018 Is what a visitor sees limited to named fields so no private garage data is exposed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-008]
- [x] CHK019 Are suspended and never-approved garages excluded from the list and both counts in one rule? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] ~~CHK020 Are abuse limits (rate limiting) for an unauthenticated read addressed or explicitly out of scope? [Gap]~~ Struck: rate limiting is not in the story or its Build brief and would be scope (Principle I).

## Errors

- [x] CHK021 Is every failure class named (missing or malformed brand, unknown brand, bad cursor, unknown field) with its outcome class? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK022 Is the error body shape and code for each failure specified, not only "bad request"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK023 Is the retired-brand case distinguished from the unknown-brand case? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-009]
- [x] CHK024 Is a cursor for another brand distinguished from a malformed cursor, or are they stated to be one outcome? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]

## Non-functional and dependencies

- [x] ~~CHK025 Is a response-time or load target stated, or its absence justified? [Gap, Non-Functional]~~ Struck: the Build brief states no target (plan Performance Goals: none); inventing one is scope (Principle I).
- [x] CHK026 Is the read-only nature (no audit, event, log) stated as a requirement? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK027 Are the upstream dependencies (the brand catalogue, garage brand rows, public garage scope) and their merged state documented? [Dependency, Spec §Sources]
- [x] CHK028 Does every requirement FR-001 to FR-011 have a success criterion or scenario that can falsify it? [Traceability, Spec §Success Criteria]
